views.name: address_components
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    a."address_id",
    a."line_1" AS "line1",
    a."line_2" AS "line2",
    a."line_1" || ', ' || a."line_2" AS "full_address"
FROM Addresses a
views.description: Extracts address line components from the address record.
validated_on: What is the first and second line for all addresses?

views.name: course_counts
views.description: Selects all courses from the database.

views.name: find_math_course
views.body_sql:
SELECT T1.course_description AS description
FROM Courses AS T1
WHERE T1.course_name = 'math course'
views.description: Select the course description for the 'math course' entry.

views.name: port_chelsea_addresses
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    a."address_id" AS address,
    a."line_1" AS line1,
    a."line_2" AS line2,
    a."line_3" AS line3,
    a."city" AS city,
    a."zip_postcode" AS zip_postcode,
    a."state_province_county" AS state_province_county,
    a."country" AS country,
    a."other_address_details" AS other_address_details
FROM
    Addresses a
WHERE
    a."city" = 'Port Chelsea'
views.description: Select addresses located in Port Chelsea.

views.name: city_zip_lookup
views.body_sql: SELECT 'zip_code' AS zip_code, T1.zip_postcode AS zip_code FROM Addresses T1 WHERE T1.city = 'Port Chelsea'
views.description: Selects the zip code associated with a given city name.

views.name: department_id_degree_count
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.department_id,
  COUNT(se.degree_program_id) AS degree_count
FROM Departments AS d
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS se
  ON d.department_id = se.degree_program_id
GROUP BY
  d.department_id
views.description: Maps department IDs to their degree counts.

views.name: department_degrees
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    d."department_id",
    COUNT(se."degree_program_id") AS "degree_count"
FROM
    Departments d
JOIN
    Student_Enrolment se ON d."department_id" = se."degree_program_id"
GROUP BY
    d."department_id"
views.description: Calculates the number of degrees for each department.

views.name: max_department_degree
views.body_sql: SELECT MAX(degree_count) AS max_degree_count FROM department_degrees
views.description: Determines the maximum degree count across all departments.

views.name: departments_with_programs
views.body_sql:
SELECT t1."department_id"
FROM "Departments" AS t1
JOIN "Degree_Programs" AS t2
ON t1."department_id" = t2."department_id"
views.description: Select departments that have at least one associated program.

views.name: programs_with_degrees
views.body_sql: SELECT dp.degree_program_id AS program_id FROM Degree_Programs dp WHERE dp.degree_summary_name LIKE '%degree%'
views.description: Select programs that are degree programs.

views.name: department_program_count
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    d.department_id,
    COUNT(dp.degree_program_id) AS program_count
FROM
    Departments d
JOIN
    Degree_Programs dp ON d.department_id = dp.department_id
GROUP BY
    d.department_id
views.description: Count the number of programs associated with each department.

views.name: degree_names
views.body_sql:
SELECT "degree_program_id" AS degree_program_id, "degree_summary_name" AS degree_name
FROM "Degree_Programs"
views.description: Select all degree names from the degrees table.

views.name: engineering_programs
views.body_sql:
SELECT "degree_programs"."degree_program_id" AS "program_id", "degree_programs"."degree_summary_name" AS "program_name"
FROM "degree_programs"
WHERE "degree_programs"."department_id" = (SELECT "department_id" FROM "Departments" WHERE "Departments"."department_name" = 'Engineering')
views.description: Selects degree programs offered by the engineering department.

views.name: department_details
views.body_sql:
SELECT d."department_name", sum(case when d."department_name" = 'engineering' then 1 else 0 end) as "degree_count"
FROM Departments d
WHERE d."department_name" = 'engineering'
GROUP BY d."department_name"
views.description: Selects department name and degree count for the engineering department.

views.name: get_section_details
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.section_name,
  s.section_description
FROM Sections AS s
WHERE s.section_id = 1
views.description: Retrieve section details based on the section identifier.

views.name: sections_sel
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.section_name,
  s.section_description
FROM Sections AS s
views.description: Selects section names and descriptions from the database.

views.name: course_section_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    c.course_id,
    c.course_name,
    COUNT(s.section_id) AS section_count
FROM
    Courses c
LEFT JOIN
    Sections s ON c.course_id = s.course_id
GROUP BY
    c.course_id,
    c.course_name
views.description: Selects courses and their section counts.
counter_examples: What are the names and ids of every course with less than 2 sections?
